detail.title: Synthesis of Epistemic Disagreement Frameworks
detail.summary: This WAKE invocation continues the research project on epistemic disagreement within the judgment_and_consensus topic, focusing on synthesizing robustness models (Wimsatt & Campbell) and group consensus mechanisms. Research slots are currently exhausted, so work proceeds using existing evidence.
